name: Cake Stand
note: Cake Stand: Make the tablecloth smooth, soft lilac fabric with a few broad folds and no fine wrinkles, slightly darker than the white stand. Keep the stand, the cakes, the purple striped wall and the view.

name: Steamer Trunk
note: Steamer Trunk: Replace the grey cracked flagstones and the yellow strip with a few large, smooth, warm sandy stone slabs with soft, faint joints. Paint the wood slightly smoother, with faint, quiet grain. Keep the trunk, the straps, the brass corners, the buckles and the blue rays.

name: Quill Pen
note: Inkwell: Light the inkwell with a softer, broader light, so the right side of the bottle is a deep green rather than near-black and the cast shadow on the table is shorter and softer. Make the feather a clean white with soft grey-blue shading. Keep the bottle, the quill, the yellow stripes and the table.

name: Piano
note: Piano: Replace the cream damask wallpaper with a soft, plain pale blue wall with broad, gentle vertical stripes. Make the floor reflections slightly softer and fainter. Keep the piano, its wood color, the keys, the pedals and the view.
